title: Supabase media placeholder
description: Plain token-coloured stand-ins for media: a flat pale-grey surface (screenshots, video), a pale-grey patch that fades out towards its edges (line illustrations inside cards), or a small round avatar disc with a hairline ring. Nothing is drawn.
notes: fills the box it is given; size and position come from the parent or className
pass children to put real media in the slot
name: supabase-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description:
surface: flat pale grey (screenshots, video) · soft: pale grey that fades out at its
edges (line illustrations inside cards) · avatar: a small round grey disc

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Dashboard video")

props.name: children
props.description: real media to show instead of the empty surface
